description: React component for a quick settings menu in a web application, managing themes, toggleable components, and appearance options.

classes.name: QuickSettingsMenu
classes.description: React functional component implementing a quick settings menu with theme and tool toggles.

methods.name: reloadThemes
methods.description: Loads and sorts theme components from application items and features.

methods.name: reloadToggleableComponents
methods.description: Loads components that can be toggled in the menu, excluding themes and deprecated folders.

methods.name: toggleComponent
methods.description: Toggles a given component or theme via application mutator.

methods.name: deactivateAnyNonLayerableTheme
methods.description: Deactivates the currently active non-layerable theme.

methods.name: toggleDefaultTheme
methods.description: Resets to default theme and disables dark mode preference.
